CustomField.description: BR-15, BR-16, PD-09. When this Lead entered the lifecycle stage it currently holds. The single queryable stage-entry timestamp PD-09 approved - deliberately NOT one field per stage and NOT a custom history object, because Salesforce field history on Status already carries the transition trail and this answers the different question of when the current stage began. Stamped by Lead_Inbound_Before_Save on Lead creation, updated on every transition the governed policy allows, and stamped during native Salesforce Lead Conversion - validated 2026-08-27. Not manually editable: readable but not editable in every permission set that grants it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When this Lead entered its current lifecycle stage. Maintained by automation, not by hand.
CustomField.label: Lifecycle Stage Entered
